match: ^SyntaxError: await is only valid in async functions and the top level bodies of modules$
samples: SyntaxError: await is only valid in async functions and the top level bodies of modules
what: `await` is only allowed inside an `async` function or at the top level of an ES module. Wrap the call in an async function or make the file a module.
